title: Post-Quantum Coverage Register — Detached Signature Envelope
description: The detached signature over a register version. Published alongside the register as <register-basename>.v<version>.sig.json — the signature cannot live inside the register file because the canonical hash is computed over that file's entire contents. Verification procedure: (1) validate the register and compute its canonical hash with the published validator; (2) check register_hash here equals that hash and register_version matches; (3) verify `signature` over the ASCII bytes of register_hash using the ML-DSA public key obtained per the register's meta.signing.public_key_publication, with standard FIPS 204 tooling (e.g., liboqs, @noble/post-quantum); (4) check the key fingerprint against at least two independent pinning surfaces.

register_hash.description: The canonical hash of the register version this envelope signs; the signing preimage is the ASCII byte string of this value.

signer.description: offline-root: full-authority version signature. online-downgrade: valid only for versions whose diff against the predecessor is limited to status downgrades and probe notes; verifiers enforcing custody semantics must reject an online-downgrade envelope over any other change.

key_id.description: Stable identifier of the signing key (e.g., heossi-register-root-2026 or heossi-register-downgrade-2026).

public_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-384 over the public-key bytes exactly as published at the pinning surfaces, for cross-checking against them. Pinning is over the published artifact, independent of ASN.1 or other encodings.

public_key.description: Optional inline copy of the public-key bytes for convenience; verifiers must still check the fingerprint against the pinning surfaces rather than trusting the inline copy.

signature.description: ML-DSA signature over the ASCII bytes of register_hash.

predecessor_envelope_hash.description: SHA-384 of the previous version's envelope file, forming the signature chain in parallel with the register's hash chain; null for the first signed version.
